description: Estado de los embalses is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. Weekly parts of the state of the reservoirs of the Júcar Hydrographic District. It includes reservoirs belonging to the Júcar Hydrographic Confederation and other users, grouped by exploitation systems. Coverage: Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. The portal shows the English title as "Status of reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. Its keywords include Agua, Embalses. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://datos.gob.es/?q=aviso-legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
